items.title: Palantir, Caterpillar results signal 'real' AI returns, says investor
items.summary:
STORY: "We're not probably completely past all the fears, but you've had a couple of companies that really line up and indicate that spending is is real and happening, and we're getting there," Haworth said.

He added that results from Palantir and Caterpillar, along with a recovery in semiconductor stocks, have reinforced investor's confidence that spending on AI and related infrastructure is continuing.

He said more earnings reports will be needed to determine whether concerns have fully subsided, adding that healthcare will be an important sector to watch as an early user and potential beneficiary of artificial intelligence.
